_note: Written from the query text alone, before any candidate project was viewed. Grade 0 is always 'does not satisfy the intent'. Difficulty and duration are used only when the query itself states them.

AI healthcare project.2: Health or medical application of AI/ML/NLP/CV: clinical decision support, triage, medical imaging, clinical text, patient-facing health tools with a learned component.
AI healthcare project.1: Health-adjacent: hospital operations, wellness or health data analysis without a substantive learned component, or an AI project where health is only an example.

I want a computer vision project using P.2: Core task is analysing images or video, built in Python.
I want a computer vision project using P.1: Computer vision is a secondary component, the stack is not Python, or it is adjacent graphics/AR.

cybersecurity final year project.2: Core of the project is security: detection, defence, auditing, cryptography or privacy engineering.
cybersecurity final year project.1: Security is an important secondary concern of a project whose core is something else.

machine learning for agriculture.2: Machine/deep learning or computer vision applied to farming, crops, soil, livestock or agricultural markets.
machine learning for agriculture.1: Agriculture project with no learned component (sensing, control, analytics), or a generic ML project that uses agriculture only as one example.

React Flask full stack web application.2: Web application whose listed technologies include BOTH React and Flask.
React Flask full stack web application.1: Full-stack web application using React with another backend, or Flask with another frontend. React Native is not React for this query.

IoT smart home automation.2: Automation or monitoring of a home or domestic building: lighting, locks, appliances, climate, household energy.
IoT smart home automation.1: IoT sensing or automation in another setting (farm, factory, city) with directly transferable techniques.

blockchain voting system.2: Voting, ballot, election or governance-vote system on a blockchain.
blockchain voting system.1: Closely related blockchain governance, identity or participation system that is not itself a vote.

beginner NLP project.2: Natural language processing project whose stated difficulty is Beginner.
beginner NLP project.1: Natural language processing project whose stated difficulty is Intermediate. Advanced projects are not relevant to a beginner request.

deep learning image classification.2: Core task is classifying or recognising images (or image-like data such as spectrograms) with neural networks.
deep learning image classification.1: Deep learning on images for another task (segmentation, generation, detection), or image classification with classical methods.

smart attendance system.2: System that records presence or attendance automatically (vision, biometrics, BLE, RFID, geofencing).
smart attendance system.1: Attendance management without automatic presence detection, or attendance-adjacent (attendance tokens, attendance forecasting).

YOLOv8 object detection.2: Object detection project that lists YOLOv8 or is built around the YOLO family.
YOLOv8 object detection.1: Object detection or localisation project using another detector.

chatbot that answers questions from docu.2: Question answering or chat grounded in a document collection through retrieval.
chatbot that answers questions from docu.1: Chatbot not grounded in documents, or document retrieval/search without a conversational answer.

recommendation system with collaborative.2: Recommender whose core is collaborative filtering, matrix factorisation or implicit-feedback modelling.
recommendation system with collaborative.1: Other recommender types (content-based, rules, bandits, association mining) or recommenders that only use collaborative signals as one input.

fraud detection in banking transactions.2: Detecting fraudulent or anomalous financial transactions (cards, bank transfers, payments).
fraud detection in banking transactions.1: Fraud, abuse or risk detection in a neighbouring domain (insurance claims, reviews, scams) or finance risk scoring.

predict student marks and performance.2: Predicts student grades, marks or academic performance from data.
predict student marks and performance.1: Education analytics that is not grade prediction (dropout warning, knowledge tracing, item analysis, tutoring).

audio and music processing project.2: Core task is analysing, transforming or generating audio or music signals.
audio and music processing project.1: Audio is secondary (speech interface around other logic, music metadata, lyrics text).

time series forecasting stock market.2: Forecasting financial market prices, returns or volatility.
time series forecasting stock market.1: Time-series forecasting in another domain, or finance analytics that does not forecast.

mobile app development with React Native.2: Mobile application whose listed technologies include React Native.
mobile app development with React Native.1: Other mobile application (Flutter, Kotlin, native) or React web project.

docker kubernetes devops pipeline.2: Delivery/infrastructure pipeline project that lists Docker or Kubernetes.
docker kubernetes devops pipeline.1: DevOps or cloud-automation project without containers, or containers used in a non-DevOps project.

augmented reality mobile application.2: Augmented reality application running on a phone or tablet.
augmented reality mobile application.1: Augmented reality for headsets or other devices, or mobile VR.

robot that avoids obstacles.2: Robot or vehicle that senses obstacles and avoids them autonomously.
robot that avoids obstacles.1: Other mobile robot navigation or path planning without an explicit obstacle-avoidance focus.

encrypt files securely.2: Core is encrypting files, storage or backups.
encrypt files securely.1: Other applied cryptography or secure-data tooling (secret sharing, encrypted notes or chat, secure deletion).

resume screening for recruitment.2: Screening, ranking or analysing resumes or candidates.
resume screening for recruitment.1: Other recruitment or HR tooling (job postings, skill extraction, scam detection).

detect fake news and misinformation.2: Detecting false or misleading claims or fake news, including matching claims to fact-checks.
detect fake news and misinformation.1: Related content-integrity detection (clickbait, fake reviews, hate speech, deepfakes).

voice controlled assistant with speech r.2: Assistant, robot or application driven by spoken commands through speech recognition.
voice controlled assistant with speech r.1: Speech recognition component without assistant behaviour, or voice features that are secondary.
